description: Cross-leg conformance fixture for MX-TAB-6 dataset lens entry points. Read by DatasetCohesionTests (Swift) and dataset_conformance.rs (Rust). Both legs assert the same expectedTopAnomalyRowIndex and expectedScoreRanking.

datasetCohesion.description: 10-row fixture. Columns: score (numeric f64), category (categorical ASCII), label (categorical non-ASCII, exercises byte-order discipline). One planted outlier at row 9.

derivation.note: Hand-derived. Score column: sorted=[2,2,2,6,6,6,10,10,10,100], n=10, median=(sorted[4]+sorted[5])/2=(6+6)/2=6.0. Deviations from 6.0: {2→4 (×3), 6→0 (×3), 10→4 (×3), 100→94 (×1)}. Sorted devs=[0,0,0,4,4,4,4,4,4,94], MAD=(devs[4]+devs[5])/2=(4+4)/2=4.0. scaledMAD=1.4826*4.0. Numeric signals: rows0-2=4/scaledMAD, rows3-5=0, rows6-8=4/scaledMAD, row9=94/scaledMAD. Category freqs: A=6/10=0.6, B=3/10=0.3, C=1/10=0.1. Label freqs: αλφα=6/10=0.6, βήτα=3/10=0.3, γάμα=1/10=0.1. Rarity=-log2(p): A/αλφα≈0.7370, B/βήτα≈1.7370, C/γάμα≈3.3219. Row scores: rows0-2=4/scaledMAD+2*0.7370, rows3-5=0+2*0.7370, rows6-8=4/scaledMAD+2*1.7370, row9=94/scaledMAD+2*3.3219. Since 94/scaledMAD>>4/scaledMAD and 3.3219>1.7370>0.7370: row9>>rows6-8>rows0-2>rows3-5.

datasetComplexity.description: 9-element column with one null. Category values for entropy test.
datasetComplexity.note: Entropy computed by NeuronKit.complexity over Float32 counts [5,3,1] (for A,B,C after null exclusion). Exact Float32 value depends on NeuronKit internals; test uses >0 assertion.

datasetAssociations.description: 4-row dataset with two perfectly co-occurring columns.
datasetAssociations.note: 4 rows, 4 distinct labels (color:blue, color:red, fruit:apple, fruit:blueberry). color:red always co-occurs with fruit:apple; color:blue with fruit:blueberry. At zero thresholds, 2 bidirectional rules expected (red→apple, blue→blueberry or their reverses).
